name: uk_find_a_tender-mcp
description: Find a Tender (deals): search_postings, get_posting. Every tool maps to a documented endpoint.

tools.name: search_postings
tools.description: OCDS release package API: documented parameters are limit (default and max 100), cursor, updatedFrom, updatedTo (YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SS) and stages (planning, tender, award). `stages=tender` is fixed; there is no keyword parameter, so `query`, `category` and `min_budget` are not sent (filter client-side). Paging is by cursor, which page/limit cannot carry: `page` is ignored and only the first `limit` releases are returned. `id` is the OCDS ocid (ocds-h6vhtk-…) accepted by get_posting.

tools.name: get_posting
tools.description: `id` is the procurement ocid ('ocds-h6vhtk-hhhhhh', e.g. /api/1.0/ocdsRecordPackages/ocds-h6vhtk-000cb9); the record package's compiledRelease is mapped (tender{title, description, value, tenderPeriod}, buyer{name}). 404 when the procurement is not found.
